coverage_note: State employees and opted-in local employers under the Public Employer-Employee Relations Act, K.S.A. 75-4321 to 75-4337 (meet and confer). Teachers bargain under the Professional Negotiations Act (K.S.A. 72-2218 et seq.), not covered by this row.

governing_statute.value: Public Employer-Employee Relations Act (PEERA), K.S.A. 75-4321 to 75-4337; mandatory for the state, local employers opt in by majority vote
governing_statute.quote: The governing body of any public employer, other than the state and its agencies, by a majority vote of all the members may elect to bring such public employer under the provisions of this act

ulp_limitation_period.value: Six months: proceedings must be commenced within six months of the alleged prohibited practice
ulp_limitation_period.quote: Proceedings against the party alleged to have committed a prohibited practice shall be commenced within six months of the date of such alleged practice by service upon the accused party by the board of a written notice

who_may_bargain.value: Any person employed by a covered public agency, except supervisory employees, school-district professional employees (who use the teacher statute), elected and management officials, and confidential employees
who_may_bargain.quote: "Public employee" means any person employed by any public agency, except those persons classed as supervisory employees, professional employees of school districts, as defined by subsection (c) of K.S.A. 72-5413 , elected and management officials, and confidential employees.

scope_of_bargaining.value: Meet and confer on grievances and conditions of employment; a memorandum of agreement may cover all matters relating to conditions of employment except listed exclusions (such as subjects preempted by law)
scope_of_bargaining.quote: The scope of a memorandum of agreement may extend to all matters relating to conditions of employment, except proposals relating to (1) any subject preempted by federal or state law
